claims.text: The sources show no general right for either party to terminate for convenience. The termination rights in Section 4(a) are tied to specific events, such as non-payment, uncured material breach, or the Reseller's sales-target conditions.

citations.quote: Either Party may terminate this Agreement:
if the other Party breaches any material term or condition of this Agreement,  and fails to cure such breach within the 60 day period

claims.text: The only termination right tied to a business condition is available to the Reseller alone, and only if the Reseller terminates the Annual Minimum Commitment provisions and fails to meet the sales targets in Schedule 3.

citations.quote: upon providing thirty (30) days' written notice to Reseller if Reseller terminates the provisions of the Annual Minimum Commitment  and fails to meet the sales targets as set out in Schedule 3.

claims.text: The Reseller alone may end the agreement at renewal by giving notice within 60 days before the end of the Initial Term or a renewal term. This is a non-renewal right tied to the term, not a general termination for convenience.

citations.quote: unless terminated by Reseller within sixty (60) days prior to the expiration of the Initial Term or any renewal term

claims.text: The agreement runs for an Initial Term of five years and then renews automatically, so it is not terminable at will during the term.

citations.quote: continue in effect for a period of five (5) years (the "Initial Term"), unless sooner  terminated in accordance with the provisions set out herein.
